annotations.title: Check how machines read a site

description: Free and instant, no account: read a website the way an AI engine does before it ever answers about it. Returns which answer-engine crawlers robots.txt lets in (retrieval, which decides whether the site can be cited) and which training crawlers it blocks (which costs nothing), the identity files present (llms.txt, ai.json and the rest), whether the homepage carries Organization schema, an identity score out of 100, and the fixes that reading names. No model is asked; for whether the engines actually name the site, run analyze_site.

url.description: A public website, e.g. example.com or https://example.com

name: check_identity
